'''Marille''' was a former ''[[damane]]'' from [[Seanchan]].

== Appearance ==
She is a stout woman in her middle years. She has wide, innocent eyes.

== Activities ==
She was one of the ''damane'' captured by [[Rand al'Thor]] and sent to [[Elayne Trakand]] in [[Caemlyn]]. The [[Kin]] now look after her in the hope she will reclaim her freedom again.

She was under [[Dimana]]'s care when the former spotted [[Gawyn Trakand]] with a [[Bloodknife]]. She told him the knife he holds is the weapon of a Bloodknife, and that Bloodknives are Seanchan assassins.{{ref/book|13|33}}
